changelog: FIX (CRITICAL — Fire Stick ANRs): Customers on weak Fire Sticks were experiencing the app force-closing ~10 seconds after the home screen loaded. Root cause: an internal license-check loop was running 15× too often, causing UI recomposition pressure that exceeded the frame budget on low-end hardware. Throttled the loop to its original cadence. App startup and paywall unlock remain instant.
FIX (visibility): Crash reports for true Java crashes and ANRs were being uploaded with no `kind` tag, hiding 138 ANRs/day in the freeze-monitor noise. Both now arrive properly tagged.
FIX (Fire Stick stalls): Tightened the player's HTTPS timeouts (was 15s/20s, now 4s/8s) so failed streams surface the 'Reconnecting…' overlay inside 10s instead of staring at a black screen.
FIX: Resolved Google Play Protect 'harmful app' warning during install.
FIX: Player on-screen options menu D-pad selection.
FIX: Discovery hero TMDB backdrop fallback.
FIX: Settings shows $50 CAD / year correctly.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
